description: A wire utensil basket sits on the table with a small metal tray attached on the left, and several colorful plastic spoons, forks, and knives are scattered to the right. The left hand stays resting near the lower left, while the right hand reaches in from the right, gathers several utensils into a bundle, shifts them toward the basket, and then places the bundle into the metal tray area, letting go so the utensils remain inside.
